stops.note: named the hard, resinous tree known for its medicinal properties
adopted by Spanish colonists, who prized the wood's resin as a treatment for disease
latinized and borrowed into English, among the very first words of American indigenous origin recorded in English
stops.meaning: a resinous tropical hardwood tree, also called lignum vitae

current_meaning: a very hard, resinous tropical tree, also known as lignum vitae, historically valued for its medicinal resin
